Blocked k-fold cross-validation on contiguous water-year blocks

Source: R/splits.R
make_blocked_folds.Rd

Water years after the warm-up are cut into k contiguous blocks. In fold i, block i is "test", days within buffer_days of the test block are "buffer" (excluded from training), and everything else is "train".

Usage

make_blocked_folds(
  dates,
  k = 5,
  warmup_years = 1,
  buffer_days = 0,
  min_obs_frac = 0,
  obs = NULL
)

Arguments

dates

Date vector covering the full model run.

k

Number of folds.

warmup_years

Leading water years never scored.

buffer_days

Days excluded either side of each test block.

min_obs_frac

Optional: with obs, drop water years with less than this fraction of observed days before forming blocks.

obs

Optional observation vector aligned with dates.

Value

Long tibble: fold, date, wy, role ("train", "test", "buffer", "warmup").
